description.narrative: Programme aims to contribute towards the Nutrition of women and children under 5, targeting a 5% reduction in stunting across four years (2018-2022) The programme employs a multi-sectoral approach to tackling malnutrition including mainstreaming climate action.Naturally, Chemba District is semi- arid hence, climate change affects rain patterns, worsening access to clean and safe water, as well as a diverse healthy diet. COUNSENUTH works with the community including schools to set up infrastructure such as, trenches to control floods, bore holes and water harvesting systems to ensure access to clean and safe water. It has also worked with the Chemba local government authority in to develop a Five-Year Strategic Plan on nutrition and gender responsive climate change adaptation.
